correctness.rationale: For fixed S of size k, exactly one crossing edge has probability k^{k-1}(n-k)^{n-k-1}/n^{n-2} by two Cayley trees and a uniform joining edge. The two internal trees and join endpoints become independent uniform conditional on S; each component contributes g(m)=m(1-1/m)^{m-1} surviving leaves (g(1)=1). Summing split indicators (dividing equal-size splits by 2) yields Cov(L,B_{n,k})=b_{n,k}[g(k)+g(n-k)-ell_n]. When k=1, B=L and Var(L)>0 for n>=4. For k,n-k>=2 the proof bounds g(m)<(m+3/4)/e and ell_n>(n+3/2)/e using convergent log series and concavity, so covariance<0. Expanding gives conditional deficit -1/(2e) for both sides growing. Fresh independent Prüfer enumeration computed all mixed moments n=4..6 using exact fractions and checked formulas/signs. Algebra establishes all n>=4, not enumeration.
